subject: Mutual action plan: SSO/SCIM cutover and IP allowlist runway
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vasquez <elena.vasquez@finsecure.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan: SSO/SCIM cutover and IP allowlist runway

Elena / Michael —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together an initial mutual action plan for the SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist configuration, and service account patterns that will be required for the production cutover. The attached "redwood-finsecure-map-v1.docx" contains a timeline and who-owns-what; I've also included a short checklist.

High-level asks for kickoff:
- Exchange SAML metadata + test IdP integration (staging)
- SCIM: grant a service account (read/write groups) for group sync and confirm attribute mapping
- IP allowlist: confirm CIDR ranges and a maintenance window for adding addresses
- Service accounts: agreed naming conventions and minimal RBAC scopes (we recommend dedicated SA per environment)
- Org policy exceptions: any firewall/NAT constraints that require an exception

Proposed kickoff: Thu Dec 9 10:00 AM ET (we'll hold 45 min and invite engineering + your IT ops). Can you confirm?

Attachments: redwood-finsecure-map-v1.docx (MAP + timeline)

Next steps I will take after your confirmation:
- Share staging SAML metadata and test SP endpoints
- Provision SCIM client credentials for staging
- Prep runbook for IP add/remove and rollback steps

Thanks — I assigned owners in the doc but will summarize in the kickoff.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178

From: Elena Vasquez <elena.vasquez@finsecure.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tang <michael.tang@finsecure.com>, it-ops@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: SSO/SCIM cutover and IP allowlist runway

Thanks Logan — this looks like the right level of detail. Thu Dec 9 10:00 AM ET works for us. I've looped in Michael (IT Ops) and the central it-ops alias so we can coordinate the network change window.

A couple of clarifying points before kickoff:
1) Service account naming: we need the convention to include the tenant shortname and environment (e.g., finsecure-prod-redwood-sa). Is Redwood able to adopt that for the SA display name and key filename?
2) SCIM permissions: our SecOps prefers a dedicated SA with group:read, group:write limited to the finsecure org — can you confirm Redwood will scope to org-only?
3) Logging/retention: what's the default retention for audit logs generated by Redwood's Private deployment? We'll pull SOC2 evidence during the kickoff if needed.

I've attached our change window (change-window.pdf). If you can send the staging metadata and proposed IP ranges ahead of the meeting, we can pre-approve the maintenance window.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: SSO/SCIM cutover and IP allowlist runway

Hi all — adding implementation detail and owners so we have a clean kickoff agenda. I've attached the detailed implementation checklist and a small role-mapping doc for the SCIM attributes.

Summary of technical milestones (owners):
- SAML (staging): Redwood (Monica) will share SP metadata by EOD Wed Dec 8; FinSecure to share IdP metadata + test account. Owner: monica_patel
- SCIM: Redwood will provision a scoped SCIM client for staging with group:read, group:write limited to finsecure org. Owner: ben_carter (will generate creds and rotate keys per schedule)
- IP allowlist: Proposed ranges: 3.210.120.0/22 (host egress), 34.82.16.0/24 (control plane). FinSecure to confirm. We require a 1-hour maintenance window for the first add. Owner: it-ops alias (FinSecure) / ben_carter for rollback plan
- Service accounts: Naming convention agreed: finsecure-<env>-redwood-sa. Keys stored in customer KMS where required; Redwood will support key rotation cadence. Owner: monica_patel
- Org policies / exceptions: Any NAT/firewall exceptions should be flagged to us at least 48 hours before cutover. If a permanent exception is required, we'll open a JIRA and document the exception rationale. Owner: monica_patel

Pre-kickoff artifacts (I'll upload these to the shared doc):
- SP metadata (redwood)
- SCIM spec + attribute map (redwood)
- IP CIDR proposal (redwood)
- Rollback runbook + test checklist (redwood)

Action items before Thu kickoff:
- Elena / FinSecure: confirm the maintenance window and verify the proposed CIDRs (it-ops)
- Michael / IT Ops: confirm whether keys must live in your KMS or if temporary upload to Redwood is acceptable for staging
- Ben: prepare scoped SCIM client and share creds via secure vault

I'll confirm the CIDRs and the maintenance window by 12:00 PM ET today. Attached is our change window again for reference.
